task.description:
Write a test spec for API-09 (Request tracing) at tests/specs/API-09.md.

API-09 acceptance criteria to cover:
1. Every request gets an X-Trace-Id response header containing a UUID v4
2. If caller supplies X-Trace-Id request header, that value is used (propagation)
3. trace_id appears in every log entry during that request
4. trace_id appears in trace_id field of any error response body
5. Trace ID assigned and returned even on HTTP 401 auth failure
6. Incoming X-Trace-Id that is not a valid UUID is accepted and propagated as-is

The spec should cover:
- Unit tests (trace_context module, UUID generation, extractOrGenerate logic)
- Integration tests (actual HTTP requests verifying X-Trace-Id header, error body field, log output)
- Edge cases: missing header, malformed UUID in header, auth failure path

Reference the existing unit tests in tests/unit/test_api09_tracing.zig and identify any gaps.
acceptance_criteria: All API-09 acceptance criteria mapped to specific test cases
Unit test cases identified (referencing existing tests/unit/test_api09_tracing.zig)
Integration test cases specified for HTTP-level verification

result.summary: Test spec for API-09 (Request tracing) written to tests/specs/API-09.md. All 6 acceptance criteria mapped to test cases. 10 unit tests confirmed covered by existing tests/unit/test_api09_tracing.zig. 6 integration test cases (TC-API-09-INT-01 through INT-06) specified for HTTP-level verification including X-Trace-Id header presence, propagation, log output, error body field, 401 auth failure, and non-UUID passthrough. Gap analysis documents that integration tests need to be implemented.
